# bike-groupset

A groupset is the collective name for a bike's shifting and braking components: shifters, derailleurs,
crankset, cassette, chain, and brakes — sold and generally used as a matched set from one
manufacturer, since cross-brand compatibility within a groupset tier is not guaranteed.

The restoration project is being built around a full Shimano SLX groupset. See [[Bike Glossary]] for
the individual part names.
